{{Top|leg}}
A '''Mandalorian flashpistol''' was a weapon used by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]]. The Mandalorians used them along with [[Sword/Legends|swords]] and [[Axe/Legends|axes]] and would carry these on their [[Basilisk war droid/Legends|Basilisk war droids]].<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
